terminal.instructions: Label only explicit atomic episodes in supplied visible reasoning. Each label has a verbatim contiguous quote, zero-based occurrence, category, concluded atom and explicitly stated ordered premises. Categories: premise_consumed (uses established evidence without proving it again), positive_derivation (an actual supported inference), absence_recheck (explicit argument that a path or transition is absent), new_residual (a supported inference about the current downstream obligation), arithmetic (resource/objective computation), ambiguous (unsupported or unclear). Relations: edge, path, ready. ready ID requires both paths of that needs row. Atom and premise endpoints must appear literally in the quote. No edges or premises may be supplied from your own source knowledge. A reference/assertion alone is not a derivation. For arithmetic and ambiguous, atom and premises may be empty. Do not infer unexposed reasoning. Do not add labels merely to populate a category. Do not repair wrong IDs. Include explicit negative reasoning, but do not infer absence from missing text. You are not given arm, score or cost; supplied reasoning can still reveal its condition. Return labels in text order. Completeness is not guaranteed. Return every trace id exactly once. Replace per-line arrays with compact half-open lineRanges [start,end): start inclusive, end exclusive, with category premise_use, path_derivation, absence_argument, optimization, other or unresolved. Ranges must be ordered, gapless and cover line 0 through the exact numbered-line count; use optimization for long arithmetic/search sections and unresolved when unclear. Blank lines may inherit a surrounding section category. Do not output a category repeatedly per line. Line categories are proposals, not certified semantics. Atomic episodes should cover path/ready rederivation, absence recheck or use of an established path, including natural language with literal endpoints and stated premises. Do not emit arithmetic episodes; arithmetic remains a range category. Never invent graph premises absent from the quoted text. Do not assign arm, score or cost. These are retained independent traces; do not improve their answers.
